deploy-bot: Heads up — change window opens in 45m (2026-04-02 02:00 UTC). We'll lock pins at T-10. If you need an exemption for a hotpatch, call it out now. :bell:

jules: I'm oncall for the window. I'll own rollback if anything spikes.

maria: I've pinned v3.4.1 to canary; will mirror to prod at T-10 unless we see regressions.

aj: Quick ask — can we get an exemption for the embeddings config tweak? small runtime flag change.

maria: Only with a green smoke and review. Open a PR and @maria me in it. No manual DB changes during the window.

sre-ops: Smoke checklist (I'll run unless someone else volunteers):
```
# health
curl -sS https://prod.redwood.internal/api/health | jq .
# basic gen
curl -sS -X POST https://prod.redwood.internal/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke: ping"}' | jq .
# check p99
kubectl --context=prod top pods | grep inference
```
Expect p99 < 300ms, error rate < 0.5%. If any fail, abort promo.

deploy-bot: Pin scheduled: will apply prod pin at T-10 (01:50 UTC). Canary looks stable in last 30m.

maria: Rollback owner: jules — if error rate > 1% or any auth failures start rollback runbook (see runbook link in #eng-sre).

aj: :thumbsup: I'll watch embeddings metrics and latency dashboard.

product-ops: Release notes drafted: "v3.4.1 — production quantization fallback, libperf fix, minor scoring tweak." I'll publish post-green smoke.

jules: Kicking off smoke now. All quick checks passing, no obvious regressions. Latency within target.

deploy-bot: Promotion started at 02:00 UTC. Progress: 12/100 nodes updated. Rolling window in effect; canary -> prod step underway.

maria: :shipit: If any anomaly, escalate to #incidents and ping oncall. We'll keep quiet in other channels during the rollout. Thanks everyone.
